findings.body: applyImport calls publishJournal before its database transaction commits. If commit fails, subscribers receive a journal that never exists. Move that single publishJournal call after successful commit.

threads.body: The publishJournal call made by applyImport runs before the import transaction commits. A failed commit exposes a nonexistent journal to subscribers. Defer that same publishJournal call until commit succeeds.
previewImport divides total by len(rows). Empty rows cause division by zero. Return an empty preview before averaging.
